text: Non-residential construction spending remains stable or grows in FY2027.

condition: US recession or rate hikes delay commercial projects.

text: Flat-glass and aluminum input costs do not surge beyond 10% YoY.

condition: Energy crisis or trade war drives input costs up >15%; Apogee's pass-through is partial.

text: Q1 earnings beat signals sustainable margin expansion, not one-offs.

condition: Q1 included non-recurring items (e.g., project catch-up); Q2 shows reverting margins.

text: Apogee can maintain or grow market share in architectural metals/glass.

condition: Competition from imports (e.g., Asian glass) or prefab wall systems intensifies.

statement: Apogee's Q2 FY2027 earnings (Sept 2026) will show sequential revenue decline >5% from Q1, due to seasonal lull, causing stock to retrace to $42-44.
resolutionCriterion: Reported Q2 FY2027 revenue below $320M and EPS below $1.00; stock price <$45 within 5 trading days post-release.

oneLiner: Apogee is a US building-enclosure supplier concentrated in architectural glass, metals, and services. Its supply chain is tied to flat glass and aluminum inputs and non-residential construction demand
